long_biography.plain_text:
At St James Wood in Stradbally, property developer Sean Johnston took on a housing scheme combining traditional thatched roofs with modern interiors. Specialist thatchers worked on the homes, while a landscaping programme added planted gardens to the development on County Waterford's Copper Coast.

In November 2018, Johnston encountered staffing software Bizimply while serving as a director of Causeway Hospitality. Within weeks, the company had implemented it. The new system let managers cost staff rosters and compare labour spending with hotel sales, replacing paper timesheets and repeated manual entry of payroll information.
long_biography.html:
At St James Wood in Stradbally, property developer Sean Johnston took on a housing scheme combining traditional thatched roofs with modern interiors. Specialist thatchers worked on the homes, while a landscaping programme added planted gardens to the development on County Waterford's Copper Coast.

In November 2018, Johnston encountered staffing software Bizimply while serving as a director of Causeway Hospitality. Within weeks, the company had implemented it. The new system let managers cost staff rosters and compare labour spending with hotel sales, replacing paper timesheets and repeated manual entry of payroll information.

confidence.reason: The primary sales brochure personally names Johnston as developer and describes thatching, interiors, landscaping and Stradbally's setting. The supplier's customer case study expressly records his November 2018 encounter with the software, implementation within weeks, and the managers' new rostering and payroll capabilities.

Their portfolio consists of some of the most notable commercial and residential properties in Waterford City, as well as a number of prominent hospitality establishments, ranging from hotels and restaurants to bars and nightclubs.
